scripts.dev: npm run build -w @cell-clash/shared && concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @cell-clash/web" "npm run dev -w @cell-clash/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cell-clash/shared && npm run build -w @cell-clash/web && npm run build -w @cell-clash/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cell-clash/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cell-clash/web && npm run typecheck -w @cell-clash/server
